entries.name: Evasion
entries.notes: SHIPPED — id, kind and element-variant expansion kept verbatim per naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies (g.evade's sole existingFamilies entry). `roles` is the evade column of ssot-affixes.md §4.3's role x group matrix, translated from the stale 12-role table to core.v1.json's 15 ids: head-protective->head-guard, sense-utility->sense, core-protective->core-guard, mantle-utility->mantle, footing/jewel-major stay, jewel-minor->jewel-minor-a and jewel-minor-b, armament-secondary stays. manipulator-offense, girdle-resource, armament-primary and the commander-only `standard` row all carry weight 0 for evade and are correctly absent — no offense-hand slot dodges better for wearing this. `variants: elements+omni` matches the per-element channels DerivedStatChannels.cs already ships (CombatDodgeFire/Ice/Air/Earth/Light/Dark alongside CombatDodgeOmni, both read by CombatDerivedReader.Dodge), the same shape as elemental_power. `nameWords.prefix` is authored fresh for this wave: ssot-affixes.md §4.12's illustrative word table names only one confirmed word pair for this family ('Shifting' humanoid / 'Deep-rooted' plant override, band B) and does not enumerate a per-element breakdown, so these six extend that gap the way the on-hit partition minted words for atom.retribution where no table existed at all — a plant swaying a stray hit aside, not a nimble step, per entry-shapes.md's own plant-override template for this exact family ('chance to sway aside'). `powerBand: medium` is the baseline the six new Increased/Replace siblings below are judged against. RUNTIME: `stat.derived` is quarantined None/None/None (D6) until E12's BattleStatComposer; this row imports and binds nowhere today, a known and scheduled gap, not a reason to author it differently.

entries.name: Startle Reflex
entries.notes: NEW family minted on this group's reserved `evd` stem (naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies), word `flinch` — short and mechanical, the reflex a body makes right before a blow lands, whether it startles upright or a leaf curls shut. Increased against evasion's Flat is the same split `ferocity` makes against `might` and `elpw-amplify` against `elemental_power`: Flat adds resolver points, Increased scales them, and the two compose differently against everything else on the actor. Same group, so `roles` is identical to evasion's row above — that repetition is the matrix, not copy-paste. `powerBand: low` against evasion's `medium` is the same relative-pull judgement the elpw-amplify exemplar makes for its own sibling. RUNTIME: quarantined None/None/None (D6) with evasion, same gap, same schedule.

entries.name: Braced Footing
entries.displayTemplate: dodge against {element} attacks never falls below {value}
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `evd`, word `brace`. Fills the op the Flat/Increased pair above leaves untouched: a floor rather than an addition — dodge against the named element never drops below this atom's resolved value, regardless of what else is or is not on the actor, the literal reading of `Replace` being one of the derived side's own four ops (Flat|Increased|Replace|Flag, no More — atom-catalog-ssot.md). No shipped `stat.derived` family demonstrates Replace's exact compose order today (does it override every other contributor outright, or only ones it would otherwise beat?), so this is a considered judgement call about what the affix MEANS, not a confirmed runtime mechanic — flagged here rather than guessed silently, the same spirit as the exemplar README's own two open gaps. `powerBand: low`, deliberately conservative so a guaranteed floor reads as a safety net rather than a build-around. RUNTIME: quarantined None/None/None (D6), same as every entry in this file.

entries.name: Tempered Hide
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `evd`, word `harden` — a surface toughened by exposure, bark or skin alike. `combat.crit.resist.*` already carries one Flat family, `stoicism`, but its id sits in naming.v1.json's `g.ward` stem, not `g.evade` — this partition owns only the Increased sibling, minted here on its own stem, the same Flat/Increased split evasion and evd-flinch make above. Same `roles` row as every other entry in this file (one row per role per GROUP, not per family). `powerBand: low`, the scaling companion to a Flat baseline this partition does not itself author. RUNTIME: quarantined None/None/None (D6).

entries.name: Old Growth
entries.displayTemplate: resistance to {element} critical hits never falls below {value}
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `evd`, word `scar` — something old enough to have taken its worst hit already, a gnarled trunk or a veteran's old wound, and rarely finds a new one that bad. The floor sibling for `combat.crit.resist.*`, same Replace judgement call as evd-brace above (the compose order Replace resolves against is a generator-time question, not an authoring one). `powerBand: low`, same conservative reasoning as every Replace family in this file. RUNTIME: quarantined None/None/None (D6).

entries.name: Sealing Sap
entries.displayTemplate: {value} increased reduction of bonus damage from {element} critical hits
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `evd`, word `seal` — sap closing over a wound before it can widen, so the blow that lands does not land as hard. `combat.crit.resist.damage.*` already carries one Flat family, `padding`, id-owned by `g.ward`'s stem — this partition mints only the Increased sibling. `powerBand: low`. RUNTIME: quarantined None/None/None (D6). Note the reused nameWords list below (evd-husk) is deliberately a different physical idea — shell rather than sap — so the two families on the same channel-pair don't read as one idea said twice; see this file's own quality note about adjectives clustering.

entries.name: Hardened Husk
entries.displayTemplate: resistance to bonus damage from {element} critical hits never falls below {value}
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `evd`, word `husk` — an outer shell that takes the worst of a blow so the body inside does not have to. The floor sibling for `combat.crit.resist.damage.*`, same Replace judgement call as evd-brace and evd-scar above. `powerBand: low`. RUNTIME: quarantined None/None/None (D6) — the seventh and last entry in this partition, closing out the Flat(evasion)/Increased/Replace grid across all three channels this group's fiction covers: dodge, crit resistance, and mitigation of a critical hit that still lands.
